procurementTypes.name: Invitation to Bid (ITB)
procurementTypes.meaning: Formal solicitation for clearly defined requirements.

procurementTypes.name: Request for Proposal (RFP)
procurementTypes.meaning: Proposal-based procurement, often for complex services/solutions.

procurementTypes.name: Prequalification
procurementTypes.meaning: Registration/qualification of suppliers, contractors or consultants.

procurementTypes.name: Goods / Supply
procurementTypes.meaning: Supply and often installation of products/equipment.

procurementTypes.name: Works
procurementTypes.meaning: Construction, civil works, rehabilitation or installation.

procurementTypes.name: Non-Consulting Services
procurementTypes.meaning: Operational service delivery distinct from professional consulting.

procurementTypes.name: Individual Consultant
procurementTypes.meaning: Specialist individual assignment with defined deliverables.
